title: Christmas and New Year in Madeira 2026: Lights, Markets and Fireworks
description: Funchal Christmas lights run 1 December to 10 January and the New Year fireworks light up 31 December. Dates, tips and how to watch them from the water.
heroAlt: Champagne on ice aboard a boat with Funchal in the distance
